{
  "method": "To evaluate the financial performance and position of Better Look Ltd, we will use various financial ratios. The current ratio is calculated as current assets divided by current liabilities. The stock turnover ratio is calculated as cost of goods sold divided by average inventory. The debt/equity ratio is calculated as total debt divided by total equity. The return on equity ratio is calculated as net income divided by total equity. The dividend pay-out ratio is calculated as dividends per share divided by earnings per share.",
   "calculations": [
      {"label": "Current Ratio 2008", "expression": "(220000 + 150000) / (120000 + 80000)"},
      {"label": "Current Ratio 2009", "expression": "(250000 + 180000) / (150000 + 100000)"},
      {"label": "Stock Turnover Ratio 2008", "expression": "540000 / ((150000 + 120000) / 2)"},
      {"label": "Stock Turnover Ratio 2009", "expression": "720000 / ((120000 + 180000) / 2)"},
      {"label": "Debt/Equity Ratio 2008", "expression": "(80000 + 120000) / (220000 + 150000 - (80000 + 120000))"},
      {"label": "Debt/Equity Ratio 2009", "expression": "(100000 + 150000) / (250000 + 180000 - (100000 + 150000))"},
      {"label": "Return on Equity Ratio 2008", "expression": "70000 / (220000 + 150000 - (80000 + 120000))"},
      {"label": "Return on Equity Ratio 2009", "expression": "90000 / (250000 + 180000 - (100000 + 150000))"},
      {"label": "Dividend Pay-out Ratio 2008", "expression": "20000 / 70000"},
      {"label": "Dividend Pay-out Ratio 2009", "expression": "30000 / 90000"}
   ],
   "keyPoints": [
      "Calculation of current ratio for both years",
      "Calculation of stock turnover ratio for both years",
      "Calculation of debt/equity ratio for both years",
      "Calculation of return on equity ratio for both years",
      "Calculation of dividend pay-out ratio for both years",
      "Comparison of the ratios between the two years",
      "Interpretation of the results in the context of the company's financial performance and position"
   ]
}
